source_summary: Tall vertical Chinese landscape with distant ink-wash peaks, craggy forested slopes, layered scroll-like mist banks, dense pine and deciduous groves, small scholar figures among rocks, and a winding foreground watercourse. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper tone are excluded.

motifs.name: distant_peak_ridge
motifs.description: Upper mountain skyline: tall central peak with surrounding jagged grey peaks and faint reddish background pinnacles, isolated from the blank sky and inscription area.
must_preserve: pale grey vertical wash on peak faces
fine dark contour lines and crackle-like rock texture
peppered black vegetation dots along ridges
soft mist fading at mountain bases
muted red-orange accent peaks in the distance

motifs.name: central_craggy_waterfall_slopes
motifs.description: Middle craggy mountain mass with steep dark wooded slopes and branching pale waterfall or ravine lines descending through the rocks.
must_preserve: white negative-space waterfall channels
dark stippled pine forests on ridgelines
angular ink outlines of rock faces
brown-red leaf accents scattered on ledges
layered grey-green washes in the cliff shadows

motifs.name: upper_left_scroll_cloud_bank
motifs.description: Compact rounded cloud bank at the left-middle, composed of clustered curling cloud forms sitting in front of dark trees and rocks.
must_preserve: rounded scalloped cloud outlines
spiral interior curls
soft white reserved cloud body
subtle grey shading under cloud edges
contrast with dark tree silhouettes behind without absorbing the trees

motifs.name: central_mist_cloud_belt
motifs.description: Large horizontal belt of swirling white mist crossing the center-right of the composition, partially veiling cliffs and forests.
must_preserve: dense curling brush loops
irregular cloud edge that wraps around trees and rocks
white reserved mist shapes
light grey wash shadows within the cloud mass
small openings where dark foliage peeks through

motifs.name: left_rocky_pine_grove
motifs.description: Left lower hillside grove with tall slender trunks, dark pine crowns, exposed rocks, and a small rustic roof-like structure nestled among the trees.
must_preserve: thin vertical tree trunks
dark blue-green stippled foliage
angular tan-grey rocks at the base
delicate branch linework
small sloped roof geometry partly hidden in the grove

motifs.name: scholars_under_pines
motifs.description: Small group of robed scholar figures seated and standing among rocks beneath spreading pine branches in the lower middle area.
must_preserve: tiny pale robes with minimal ink outlines
seated and standing figure poses
surrounding rock seats and footpath shapes
overhanging pine boughs with needle clusters
scale relationship between figures, rocks, and trees

motifs.name: red_trunk_cliff_pine
motifs.description: Prominent left foreground pine rising from a rocky cliff, with twisting reddish-brown trunk, dark foliage masses, and red leaf accents.
must_preserve: sinuous reddish-brown trunk and exposed roots
dense dark stippled pine canopy
red-orange foliage accents
layered cracked rock ledges
fine needle texture and branch joints

motifs.name: foreground_watercourse_and_willows
motifs.description: Lower foreground water scene with winding stream or pool, rippling current lines, pale rounded willow-like trees, dark bank shadows, and rocky banks.
must_preserve: concentric and flowing water ripple lines
pale clustered leaf dots on rounded trees
dark ink wash reflections and bank shadows
gnarled tree trunks and branching linework
rocky shoreline contours and small gravel textures

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
